cases.purpose: Check exact shell descriptor-number sets after missing and regular operands, action/device continuation and usage failures.
cases.oracle: Linux regular files return ENOTTY to block ioctls; a missing path returns ENOENT; builtin contract requires action and device continuation and usage status 2.
cases.comparison: Exact status, ordered diagnostic classification, and descriptor-number sets before and after each call in the same shell; no diagnostic wording comparison beyond device and errno.
cases.script:
export LC_ALL=C
fds() { local f; REPLY=; for f in /proc/$BASHPID/fd/*; do REPLY+="${f##*/} "; done; }
fds; before=$REPLY
blockdev --getsz --getro missing img-a img-b >out 2>err; rc=$?
fds; [[ $before == "$REPLY" ]] && echo 'failure fds unchanged' || echo 'failure fds changed'
printf 'failure status=%s\n' "$rc"
mapfile -t lines <err
printf 'failure diagnostics=%s\n' "${#lines[@]}"
[[ ${lines[0]} == *missing*'No such file or directory'* && ${lines[1]} == *img-a*'Inappropriate ioctl for device'* && ${lines[2]} == *img-a*'Inappropriate ioctl for device'* && ${lines[3]} == *img-b*'Inappropriate ioctl for device'* && ${lines[4]} == *img-b*'Inappropriate ioctl for device'* ]] && echo 'failure order ok' || echo 'failure order wrong'
[[ ! -s out ]] && echo 'failure stdout empty' || echo 'failure stdout nonempty'
fds; before=$REPLY
blockdev --bogus img-a >out 2>err; rc=$?
fds; [[ $before == "$REPLY" ]] && echo 'usage fds unchanged' || echo 'usage fds changed'
printf 'usage status=%s\n' "$rc"
cases.stdout:
failure fds unchanged
failure status=1
failure diagnostics=5
failure order ok
failure stdout empty
usage fds unchanged
usage status=2
